title: Erik Cederberg - Articles on Car Auctions & Enthusiast Culture
description: Read articles and posts by Erik Cederberg about car auctions, classic cars and enthusiast culture. Expert insights and reports from Bidders Highway.
mainHtml:
Erik Cederberg

Erik Cederberg is the auction manager at Bidders Highway. Erik is without a doubt the person in Sweden who has bought, sold, driven, raced, and talked the most cars in all of Sweden, ever. His credentials range from winning the Carrera Pan Americana in Mexico and the American Street Car Series (twice) to crossing Europe (alone) in a Ferrari 456 GT when he was 17 years old!
